四轮鼓式制动、双回路主缸、液压管路、驻车拉索及制动踏板。: Four drum brakes, dual-circuit master cylinder, hydraulic lines, parking-brake cables and brake pedal.

从驾驶席中间的制动踏板追到主缸，再比较四轮制动鼓内的蹄片和弹簧。: Follow the brake pedal to the master cylinder, then compare the shoes and springs inside the four drums.

比较前部上下摆臂与后部控制臂，观察弹簧、减振器和衬套的连接位置。: Compare the front upper and lower control arms with the rear arms. Find the spring, damper and bushing connections.
离合踏板和拉索、换挡机构、变速器、差速器、半轴与万向节。: Clutch pedal and cable, shift linkage, transmission, differential, half shafts and universal joints.
离合器接合或切断发动机动力，齿轮机构改变传动关系，差速器允许两侧驱动轮以不同转速: The clutch connects or disconnects engine power. Gears change the drive ratio, while the differential lets the driven wheels turn at different speeds.
先看离合踏板与换挡杆，再查看后部离合器、齿轮组及通向后轮的半轴。: Start with the clutch pedal and gear lever, then inspect the rear clutch, gears and half shafts leading to the rear wheels.
完整的精细发动机、冷却导风、化油器、点火与充电附件，以及加速踏板。: Detailed engine, cooling ducts, carburetors, ignition and charging equipment, and accelerator pedal.
活塞通过连杆驱动曲轴；配气机构控制进排气，化油器调节混合气，风扇和导风罩引导冷却: Pistons drive the crankshaft through connecting rods. The valvetrain controls intake and exhaust, carburetors meter the mixture, and the fan and shrouds direct cooling air.

从前部油箱沿车底供油钢管追踪到后部；化油器与燃油泵位于发动机总成。: Follow the steel fuel line from the front tank beneath the car toward the rear. The carburetors and fuel pump belong to the engine assembly.

各缸排气经歧管与管道汇流，通过消声器后排出；管路和支承件把热气流与车身分隔。: Exhaust from the cylinders joins in the manifolds and pipes before passing through the mufflers. Pipes and supports keep hot gases away from the body.
